title: On the deployed Gate 2 batch build, re-walking fractal, ml and sub-worlds reports zero unnamed buttons: the four icon-only controls (fractal preset Save, ml DatasetHub refresh, ml ModelHub refresh, sub-worlds WorldCard Pause/Resume) expose accessible names in the Accessibility tree.
author: muse-b3
covers: Fixer muse-b7's section-F build: a11y.unnamed_control (low, count 3 - fractal, ml, sub-worlds), landed as ONE commit on v1/a11y-names @ 4064ee104 (parent f4f1f77ff), 5 files (4 edited + the pin suite), every blob read back byte-identical. PACKET FORM (author's call, flagged in the fixer's package): this recipe replays against THREE lens packets at the same build - fractal@f4f1f77ff610:v1, ml@f4f1f77ff610:v1, sub-worlds@f4f1f77ff610:v1 - the signature fired once per lens with no primary; ruling #17 requires the field to name one packet, so packet_id carries the first-named packet of the span (fractal) and the full three-packet span named here and in the steps governs the replay. Premise by execution at the fixer seat (premise-v1-a11y-unnamed.md): a brace-aware census of every button + role=button element in the three lenses' trees at f4f1f77ff (26 tsx files), every candidate read in full, located exactly four unnamed controls of one genus - an icon-only button with no text, no aria-label and no title: (1) components/fractal/FractalRenderer.tsx preset Save (Loader2/Save only); (2) components/ml/DatasetHubPanel.tsx hub refresh (Loader2/RefreshCw only); (3) components/ml/ModelHubPanel.tsx hub refresh, identical shape; (4) components/sub-worlds/WorldCard.tsx owner-only status toggle (Play/Pause only; toggles the world paused/active via set_status). The fix adds the missing names in the house form: aria-label + title 'Save preset' on (1); 'Refresh datasets' on (2); 'Refresh models' on (3); dynamic aria-label + title (paused ? 'Resume world' : 'Pause world') on (4), matching the Favorite button's dynamic-label pattern in the same file. Names only - no behaviour changes. Gate evidence at the fixer seat: tests/a11y-unnamed-controls.test.ts 9/9 on the fixed tree (4 site legs + 4 pristine-shape absence legs + 1 genus census leg) and 9/9 FAIL on pristine f4f1f77ff bytes; eslint 0 errors on all 5 files (2 warnings pre-existing, untouched lines); regression MlPanels.coverage + pin 34/34; neighbouring suites 36/37 with both failures attributed pre-existing by pristine reproduction (FIX-automotive-009 garage delete-confirm, no file in this diff; sub-worlds Enter-button world-travel, untouched by this change); server.js untouched, no shared-chrome files touched. Adversarial legs of record: keyboard-only pass (each control Tab-reachable, announced name matches its action); signed-out - the three lenses gate as designed, no surface renders, no name expected, no change from this fix. NOT claimed: any unnamed control outside the three lenses' censused trees, and VERIFIED - which waits on the deployed-batch re-walk.
discriminator: Pre-fix, on f4f1f77ff: the capture walk's surface check (checks.py surface(): AX-tree button nodes with an empty computed accessible name) filed 'button(s) have no accessible name' for each of fractal, ml and sub-worlds on the capture build. Fixer-seat transcript: the pin suite tests/a11y-unnamed-controls.test.ts fails 9/9 on pristine f4f1f77ff bytes (the four sites carry no name attribute; the genus census finds exactly the four icon-only buttons) and passes 9/9 on the fixed tree.
steps: On the deployed batch build, open /lenses/fractal signed in (walker t1 form). In the Presets panel, inspect the Accessibility tree: the save-preset button (Save icon, beside the preset-name input) exposes the name 'Save preset'. Run the surface check - unnamed_buttons = 0 for the lens.
Open /lenses/ml. In the Dataset Hub and Model Hub panels, the refresh buttons beside the sort selects expose 'Refresh datasets' and 'Refresh models'. Surface check: unnamed_buttons = 0.

Open /lenses/sub-worlds signed in as a world owner. On an owned world's card, the status toggle exposes 'Pause world' while the world is active and 'Resume world' while it is paused. Surface check: unnamed_buttons = 0.
Read-back: the names persist across a lens reload and across the toggle's state flip (the name follows the state).
Adversarial: keyboard-only pass - each of the four controls is reachable by Tab and its announced name matches the action it performs.
Adversarial: flip the sub-worlds toggle twice - the name alternates Pause world / Resume world in step with the world's status, never stale.
